observations.trace: Fungus review poses carry explicit FungusSpecies, and CapturePose::accepts_plant accepts only the corresponding PlantSpecies::Fungus for those poses. The viewer selects the nearest accepted anchor; generic Plant and PlantLod poses do not impose this fungus filter. Two community views use a FlyAgaric focus; this selects an anchor and does not by itself prove which other plants are visible. Isolated LOD views derive from the same catalogue while changing visibility-related flags.

conditional_findings.classification: New95e conditional reporting question connected to Segovb560 original pending width-versus-depth and metric semantics; not a new historical finding.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: If the reported vista diameter is intended to describe the full supplied geographic extent and a rectangular vista can reach capture, computing it solely from width can understate the north–south span.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Vista source-grid shape, ring extent and the capture-report metric definition; decide whether the output should be one axis, maximum extent, bounds or another documented measure.
conditional_findings.trace: VistaCaptureGeometry::from_source updates diameter using max over (lod.width−1)×spacing, without using lod.depth or the ring origin for that field. It separately calculates width/depth-based sample coordinates for extrema. VistaSummary publishes geometry.diameter() as diameter_metres. The bounded source grid validator checks width and depth independently (each at least2), matching sample lengths, finite spacing and height/environment limits; the vista loop also checks ordered level and spacing, finite origin and total samples, but the shown checks do not require width==depth. VistaCaptureContract separately constructs expected x/z bounds from both dimensions and origin.
conditional_findings.symbolic_example: For a hypothetical single 3-by-9 grid at100m spacing, source arithmetic produces a200m width value and an800m north–south extent. With27 height/environment entries and a smaller preceding playable spacing, the dimension, sample-count and spacing-order checks shown can be satisfied. This is a numerical illustration, not a constructed or fully validated scene.
conditional_findings.safeguards: The inspected dispatcher city-vista producer requests square grids and sets width=depth=side; the inspected fixture generator likewise calls grid(side, side, ...), so those normal sources are counterevidence to claiming this occurs there. Complete scene validation includes grounding and other contracts, supported rectangular producers and any downstream interpretation of diameter remain unproved. A field named diameter might intentionally mean east–west width; no specification establishes the intended semantics here. No source input, scene, camera, manifest, output or test was run.

Establish the intended report metric and consumers, including multiple origin-offset rings and whether source extents or another geometric measure is required.

acceptance_requirements: Make the reported metric unambiguous and consistent with supported vista shapes and documented meaning.
Preserve checked geographic extrema and actual sampling locations; if square rings are a required invariant, establish it at their canonical admission owner rather than assuming it locally.
